lines.en: Hello. I have a request. I need a paper.
Of course. Which paper do you need?
The paper for local citizen support.
Okay. Please fill in this form and sign here.
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 이 양식을 채우고 여기 서명해 주세요.

lines.en: Do I need one more paper?
No. Every citizen can request this paper.
lines.ko: 아니요. 모든 시민이 이 서류를 요청할 수 있어요.

lines.en: Good. I came here last year, too.
Then you know the rules. Do you come often?
Not often. This community office is very kind.
lines.ko: 자주는 아니에요. 이 지역 사무소는 아주 친절해요.

lines.en: Thank you. You will get the paper in ten minutes.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 십 분 후에 서류를 받으실 거예요.

lines.en: Excuse me. What does this sign say?
It shows the rules of the community park.
Can I walk my dog here?
Yes, but please keep it close. That's the rule.
lines.ko: 네, 하지만 가까이 두세요. 그게 규칙이에요.

lines.en: I see. Are the rules from the government?
No, the local citizens made them together last year.
lines.ko: 아니요, 지역 시민들이 작년에 함께 만들었어요.

lines.en: That's nice. Every citizen has a voice.
Yes. We often meet to talk about the park.
lines.ko: 네. 공원 이야기를 하려고 자주 모여요.

lines.en: I will come to the next meeting.
Great. Your support will help us a lot.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 당신의 지원이 큰 도움이 될 거예요.
